parent_relation.relation: Alternative exact representation and search for the same full finite-sample F2 set; not a replacement of the baseline or a local DFA learner.

hypothesis.correctness: The eager ownership formula, using one shared rejecting side per negative and singleton/pair distinguishers, has exactly the canonical ownership models corresponding to F2(S).
hypothesis.performance: Materialized constraints may prune enough partial assignments to offset formula-construction overhead; this remains unmeasured in this idea record.

motivation: Move beyond the incomplete swap/insertion-rescue graph while preserving every sample-feasible two-block partition; investigate total cost rather than assuming fewer complete candidates implies a speedup.
assumptions: Known alphabet of 2..10 distinct single-character symbols.
Exactly two nonempty disjoint ownership blocks.
Fixed finite positive and negative samples with correct, noncontradictory labels.
Global acceptance is conjunction of acceptance of block projections.
Unrestricted regular local factors; no state bound or prefix-closure assumption.
No extra labels, target-generator structure, active oracle or RPNI call is available to the solver.
